Night sky & credits
Fixed winter sky near Merredin: 31.48°S, 118.28°E; 15 June 2026, 7:30 pm AWST. The highway faces east. Stellar coordinates are precessed from J2000; atmospheric refraction and proper motion are omitted. Moon lighting remains the game’s artistic lighting.
Stars: XHIP, Anderson & Francis (2012), converted by Olaf Frohn in d3-celestial. Milky Way: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio; Ernie Wright; Gaia DR2: ESA/Gaia/DPAC. Brightness adapted for the game.

  
Controls & roadside help
W / ↑ accelerate · S / ↓ brake · A D / ← → steer
Stop, release the brake, then hold it again to reverse.
Xbox controller: left stick steers · RT accelerates · LT brakes, then reverses.
Trigger pressure selects speed · Menu pauses · Y headlights · X radio.
Connect your controller and press a button, then release the sticks and triggers to enable driving.
Pull off the road and stop to repair. Damage increases fuel use; repairs restore efficiency.
Stop at a roadhouse to refuel. Leave more braking distance on wet roads.
Pull onto the shoulder for a hitchhiker; park in their marked bay to drop them off.
